extraction: Only large per-episode/per-class arrays, file-hash maps, and raw audit arrays omitted; metric values unchanged.

report.scope: GT-privileged expressivity diagnostic, not a deployable method
report.question: Can a correct existing complete hypothesis be selected by any positive convex combination of actual reference-FG directions, and is this capability specific to FG rather than equal-count BG directions?
report.scores: For source token t and hypothesis H, r_t dot raw mean(q_H); stored unit-mean projections multiplied by mean norm.
report.families: All FG; deterministic equal-count FG/BG source controls using RandomState0 without labels from query.
report.simple_controls: Uniform source mean and single-source-token attainable choices, with mean included to preserve baseline coverage.
report.margin_note: Strict margin above1e-7 on unique masks certifies attainability; fixed tie cases include known mean/single-anchor choices. No GT-dependent weight choice is presented as an algorithm.
report.failure_scope: If foreground and background families both recover the bank oracle, the oracle freedom is not specific identity evidence; if restricted oracle fails, it rejects only this readout family, not all DINO information.
